tech.summary: Just two days after the US ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek's AI technology over security concerns, the Chinese lab raised about $15 billion (~100 billion yuan) — one of China's biggest rounds ever, per Bloomberg. Backers include CATL and Tencent; the round doubled from its original 50 billion yuan target, with a possible STAR Market IPO ahead.
tech.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US federal ban

tech.summary: OpenAI announced it has acquired Orchestra Bio, whose AI agents help biopharma teams coordinate the complex work of drug development, folding the team into its Rosalind life-sciences unit. The company says AI can compress the 10-15 year drug journey from target discovery to US approval; terms were not disclosed.
tech.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to bring AI agents into drug development

tech.summary: Anthropic is donating the Agent Skills open standard — the SKILL.md format adopted by 70+ agent platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and VS Code, with 1 million skills published — to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, where it joins the Model Context Protocol. Engineers from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI will maintain it.
tech.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Linux Foundation

tech.summary: OpenAI is reportedly close to raising up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, led by Coatue and UAE investors — down from an earlier $1.4T figure, with FT reporting softer investor demand than prior rounds. If closed, it would be the most valued private company ever, ahead of a planned IPO.
tech.title: OpenAI working on $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO

tech.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to explore a possible merger — which would rank as the biggest corporate tie-up in history at ~$3.5 trillion combined. Musk says it has 'a lot of merit' for AI cooperation but stresses the deal is not a certainty; Tesla shareholders must approve with a 50pc vote of all shares.
tech.title: Musk: SpaceX and Tesla exploring possible merger

tech.summary: Ex-OpenAI CPO Kevin Weil, ex-Meta AI leader Manohar Paluri and DJ Patil launched Warp Sciences, raising $215M in Series A led by Lightspeed with Premji Invest participating. The startup pairs AI with robotic labs running around the clock to generate real-world data for drug discovery — with scientists, not AI, in charge of the questions.
tech.title: Ex-OpenAI, ex-Meta leaders raise $215M for AI drug-discovery startup

pakistan.summary: World Bank's 'Attaining Escape Velocity' report says upgrading policies to average middle-income standards could drive 6.2-6.9pc annual growth, taking Pakistan to Vietnam's current income level by 2050. FY26 GDP growth hit 3.7pc, and the country returned to international debt markets with a $3 billion Eurobond — but per-capita growth remains stuck at 1.6pc.
pakistan.title: World Bank: Faster reforms could triple Pakistan's incomes by 2050

pakistan.summary: The IMF forecast in its Dubai regional outlook that output in Pakistan, the Middle East and North Africa will contract 1.3pc this year due to the US-Israeli-led war against Iran's impact on energy, shipping and trade, then rebound to 6.6pc growth in 2027. Oil importers like Pakistan proved more resilient, helped by remittances and prompt policy responses.
pakistan.title: IMF: Pakistan, Middle East and N. Africa GDP to contract 1.3pc in 2026

pakistan.summary: The 'Pakistan Entrepreneurship and Private Investment Catalyst Project', expected for World Bank Board approval in early 2027, will help set up a $50 million Fund of Funds investing in professionally managed VC funds — addressing Pakistan's long-standing gap in early-stage and growth capital for innovative, high-growth firms.
pakistan.title: World Bank to support Pakistani start-ups with $50m fund-of-funds

pakistan.summary: On his first Peshawar visit since Oct 11's governor's rule, PM Shehbaz chaired the apex committee with Field Marshal Asim Munir, promised Rs160bn in uplift funds for KP, and accused PTI of 'callousness' and 'criminal negligence' — citing 5,000 unfilled police vacancies and incomplete Safe City projects.
pakistan.title: PM vows to 'bring back progress' to KP, assails PTI's 'callousness'

pakistan.summary: At a meeting with leading exporters, Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan acknowledged mounting pressure from rising energy, transport and freight costs, higher taxation and shifting global trade. Textile body PHMA urged reinstatement of the Export Facilitation Scheme in its original form, warning policy changes are hurting cash flow.
pakistan.title: Export sector warns of losing competitiveness

pakistan.summary: Petrol was cut by Rs1.60 per litre to Rs377.71 and diesel raised Rs1.64 to Rs391.75, effective Oct 23 — the second straight day of revisions after a Rs2.71 petrol cut. Brent crude touched $111.24, a five-month high, while taxes and duties on petrol remain around Rs114 per litre.
pakistan.title: Petrol cut to Rs377.71, diesel up to Rs391.75 for Oct 23
